item.title: Shunali Khullar Shroff’s ‘The Wrong Way Home’ Celebrates Singlehood In All Its Messy Glory
item.description: Shunali Shroff's 'The Wrong Way Home' shows our male-centred culture that another world is possible, through Nayantara's reclamation of singlehood.
